title: SR-1.04 Cloud connectors: no bearer in the URL, proof of possession
request: Closes G04: Connector URLs embed the bearer token in the path (logged by tunnel providers); cloud tokens are plain replayable bearers. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: OAuth-only connectors
requirements: memev cloud url prints a URL with no secret in it; claude.ai and ChatGPT connect through the OAuth flow

path tokens, and cloud-connector mv_ tokens sent in the Authorization header, are refused through the tunnel under the default configuration; memev doctor warns, naming the connector, while a cloud connector still holds an mv_ token and has no OAuth grant, and says how to reconnect it through OAuth

tasks.title: Short-lived access tokens with rotation
requirements: access tokens live at most one hour, refresh tokens rotate on use and a reused refresh token revokes the family

access tokens are bound to a key the client holds (DPoP, RFC 9449): the token names the key's thumbprint, every request carries a fresh proof signed by that key over the method, the URL and a time, and the server refuses a token presented without a matching proof or with a replayed one
a client that cannot hold a key (a connector that supports only bearer tokens) is listed in docs/CLOUD.md by name with the reason, and its tokens live at most 15 minutes

the server verifies the proof's signature with the public key in its header, accepting only the algorithms its metadata lists and never alg none, before it compares that key's RFC 7638 thumbprint with the token's
a DPoP-bound token needs a valid proof on every route, /mcp and each /v1 route alike, and is refused in the Bearer scheme whether or not a proof comes with it

a token request with no proof is refused unless the client's registered name is on the bearer-only list that src/server/oauth.mjs exports; each name on the list is in docs/CLOUD.md with its reason, and its access tokens live at most 900 seconds
the authorization-server metadata lists dpop_signing_alg_values_supported, the protected-resource metadata lists the DPoP method, and a 401 carries a DPoP challenge
a refresh of a DPoP-bound pair needs a fresh proof from the key the pair is bound to, and the new access token stays bound to it

a proof is accepted only with iat no more than 5 minutes from the server's clock, htm equal to the request method and htu equal to the request URL as the client sent it; a used jti is remembered across a restart for as long as its proof could be accepted
reusing a refresh token revokes its whole family, the newer pair included; the record of used refresh tokens survives a restart, and a refresh token the store does not know revokes nothing

criteria.statement: A reused refresh token revokes every token in its family
The full suite passes

Test 'SR-1.04 possession signature'. The test builds its proofs itself with node:crypto as RFC 9449 compact JWS (typ dpop+jwt, ES256, ieee-p1363 signature), not with a helper imported from src/. Three proofs carry the token's own public JWK in their header and a fresh jti, iat, htm and htu: (a) signed by another key, (b) with one signature byte flipped, (c) with alg 'none' and an empty signature. Each gets 401 on POST /mcp through the tunnel. The same proof correctly signed gets 200.
